details: MMSD labels denote multimodal sarcasm on Twitter; no evidence of interpersonal target or covert hostility is verified.
SarcNet labels denote unimodal vs multimodal sarcasm in Chinese/English; labels cannot be converted into passive aggression.
GoEmotions labels fine-grained affective states; disapproval and annoyance are not equivalent to covert passive aggression.
Civil Comments annotates overt toxicity and insults. Overt aggression lacks plausible deniability and is excluded by operational definition.
Sitcom dialogue sarcasm involves script humor and bantering; lacks genuine covert interpersonal hostility.
Raw iSarcasm files contain unhydrated tweet IDs and sarcasm labels.
Llama 3.2 and Qwen 2.5 disagreed on primary label in Phase 5A; quarantined from silver training set.
Sincere praise and self-confessions erroneously labeled PA by both models under prompt v1.
Adjudicator assigned ambiguous due to unassessed images or missing context; excluded from binary classification.
